About Me

Science Explained
Simply & Smartly

I am deeply passionate about teaching and believe every student deserves to understand science — not just memorize it. With a warm, engaging style and a sharp eye for where students struggle, I make complex concepts feel natural and achievable.

My approach is built around clarity first. Whether you're preparing for board exams or trying to build a rock-solid foundation, I guide you step by step, concept by concept, until it truly clicks.

I personally mentor each online student, giving focused attention to their unique learning pace and goals — because every student is different, and every student can excel.
